Pixel Swarm: full playthrough

All 102 levels completed

Every level of Pixel Swarm v1.0.0 (5 themes × 3 difficulties × 6 levels, plus the 12 Halloween event levels) was played from a fresh install with real taps on the game's buttons. After each win the script checked the reward paid, the stars saved and which level opened next. Below each level is its own Level Complete screen, captured at the moment it was won.

Bug found on the way

BUG-008 major reproduced 2/2

Player XP never grows: after 102 wins the player is still level 1, so the Firefly bug and two avatars can never be unlocked

Expected: Wins give XP, the player levels up (the Profile promises 'Next reward: 50' coins) and level-gated content opens: Firefly at level 5, avatars at levels 10 and 20

Actual: XP stays 1/2 and the player stays level 1 after 1, 2, 3 and 102 wins. The Firefly and all 7 of its looks say 'Unlocks at player level 5'; two avatars stay locked.

Fix: In track('level') add XP per win (e.g. 1 per star), level up when xp >= xpToNext (grow xpToNext, pay LEVEL_UP_REWARD, show a toast), then re-render the HUD.

Video and data: bug report

How it was played

  • Fresh browser profile: age gate, story and welcome screen, then the tutorial level with all 6 tutorial steps.
  • Every move is a real click on a block in the game. The order follows the solution order of the game's own solver (columns in rotation, one block at a time), read from what is on screen. The auto-solve, level skip and win cheats were never used.
  • Logged economy aid: 500 gems from the debug menu, spent in the Speed Store on the permanent 8x speed. At the start of every level the player taps the speed button up to 8x.
  • After each win: the reward shown, the coins actually paid, the stars saved and the next level were checked. After each 6-level section the page was reloaded to confirm the progress was saved.
  • When the test run was stopped and moved to a durable folder, the browser was closed about a second after a win, before that win reached the disk. The game then correctly kept the next level locked. The script compares the save with the inventory on every start, so the lost win (#64) was played again and the section continued. This was a test-harness interruption, not a game bug; the persistence check taken during it (sweets-medium: 3 in the save after reload) is not counted above.
  • The Level Complete screenshots of levels 1-50 were taken while the popup was still fading in, so they look faint; from level 51 on the script waits for the popup to finish. The save data in the inventory confirms every win either way.
  • No reward, star or unlock mismatch was found during the run.

Recorded with the full-playthrough skill (game-qa-skills). Row-by-row data: inventory.md · event log: playthrough-log.md · script: scripts/playthrough.mjs
